4969/// Returns the index pointer for code point `code` in this index.
4970#[inline]
4971pub fn backward(code: u32) -> u16 {
4972    let offset = (code >> 5) as usize;
4973    let offset = if offset < 2048 {BACKWARD_TABLE_UPPER[offset] as usize} else {0};
4974    BACKWARD_TABLE_LOWER[offset + ((code & 31) as usize)]
4975}
